name: KromiumPdfSettings
summary: Comprehensive configuration settings for exporting web pages to vector PDF documents.
declaration:
data class KromiumPdfSettings @JvmOverloads constructor(
    val landscape: Boolean = false,
    val printBackground: Boolean = false,
    val scale: Double = 1.0,
    val paperSize: KromiumPaperSize = KromiumPaperSize.A4,
    val preferCssPageSize: Boolean = false,
    val margins: KromiumPdfMargins = KromiumPdfMargins.Default,
    val pageRanges: String = "",
    val displayHeaderFooter: Boolean = false,
    val headerTemplate: String = "",
    val footerTemplate: String = "",
    val createDirectories: Boolean = false,
    val generateTaggedPdf: Boolean = false,
    val generateDocumentOutline: Boolean = false
)

constructors.signature: KromiumPdfSettings(landscape: Boolean = false, printBackground: Boolean = false, scale: Double = 1.0, paperSize: KromiumPaperSize = KromiumPaperSize.A4, preferCssPageSize: Boolean = false, margins: KromiumPdfMargins = KromiumPdfMargins.Default, pageRanges: String = "", displayHeaderFooter: Boolean = false, headerTemplate: String = "", footerTemplate: String = "", createDirectories: Boolean = false, generateTaggedPdf: Boolean = false, generateDocumentOutline: Boolean = false)

parameters.name: landscape
parameters.description: True for landscape orientation, false for portrait.

parameters.name: printBackground
parameters.description: True to print CSS background graphics, gradients, and colors.

parameters.name: preferCssPageSize
parameters.description: True to prefer page size defined by CSS @page rule.

parameters.name: pageRanges
parameters.description: Page ranges to print (e.g. '1-5, 8, 11-13'). Empty prints all pages.

parameters.name: displayHeaderFooter
parameters.description: True to display HTML header and footer.

parameters.name: createDirectories
parameters.description: True to automatically create missing parent directories for target file.

parameters.name: generateDocumentOutline
parameters.description: True to generate document outline (bookmarks) from headers.
